title: Binary Pixel Carrier
shows: A black/white field and a bitstream can be the same finite object under different interpretations.
does_not_show: That high-dimensional interpretations create free information or better AI.

title: Color Pixel Carrier
source: one RGB888 color + one comparison color
operation: serialize / color-space transforms / perceptual comparison / palette accounting
measure: stored bits, derived coordinates, color distance, contrast, indexed-vs-direct bits
shows: Color adds finite multi-channel state while exact storage, deterministic derivations, relational measurements, and assigned semantics remain distinguishable.
does_not_show: That color coordinates are independent source dimensions or that RGB uniquely determines spectrum, wavelength, polarization, material, illumination, or semantic meaning.

title: Corruption & Error Correction
shows: Redundancy can trade transmitted bits for recoverability.
does_not_show: Perfect correction at arbitrary noise; Hamming(7,4) corrects one error per 7-bit block and can miscorrect multiple errors.

title: Associative Pixel Memory
shows: A binary field can be interpreted as a content-addressable attractor state.
does_not_show: That spatial pixel topology is responsible; this Hopfield model is fully connected.

title: Visual Motif Codec
measure: dictionary + index + metadata bits, decode distance
shows: Repeated spatial structure can be represented with reusable symbols and measured side information.
does_not_show: Universal compression; random fields often expand.

title: Hypervector Field
measure: address-query accuracy vs dimension, logical/storage bits
shows: The same field can be mapped into a distributed high-dimensional representation with measurable retrieval noise.
does_not_show: Additional independent source information; the high-dimensional state is derived from the original bits and shared codebook.

title: Pixel Interpretation Sandbox
interpretation: bit / integer / RGB / indexed color / hash fragment / vector / tensor / token / memory / subfield
operation: finite state accounting + fixed hand-written update rules
measure: raw state cost, state size, and inspectable dynamics
shows: Different finite data types, mathematical objects, and update factorizations can occupy the same outer address under explicit accounting.
does_not_show: Learning, superiority, compression, semantic roles, or reasoning.

title: Learned Local Vector Field
measure: train accuracy, distance-conditioned test accuracy, parameters
shows: A shared local recurrent vector field can learn a controlled spatial relation task.
does_not_show: That MPF beats ordinary CNN/NCA/Transformer controls or that the task requires a novel pixel representation.

title: WebGPU Pixel Compute
operation: NOT / dilation / edge operator in WGSL
shows: A pixel field can simultaneously be a visible object and directly addressable compute state.
does_not_show: GPU superiority for tiny arrays; timing includes submission and readback.

title: Masked Binary Reconstruction
source: structured 16×16 binary fields with hidden pixels
measure: held-out hidden-pixel accuracy vs local-majority baseline
shows: A learned hidden state can infer missing carrier values on a controlled distribution.
does_not_show: MPF advantage; the first model is intentionally a conventional convolutional control.

title: Primitive Resource Benchmark
interpretation: vector vs tensor vs inner-token pixel
measure: state scalars, parameters, runtime, near/far accuracy across seeds
shows: Different matching protocols produce different comparisons and seed variance matters.
does_not_show: A universal winner; equal-state, equal-parameter and equal-compute are distinct protocols.

title: Pixel Genome
operation: generate / mutate / cross / interpolate / damage / regenerate
measure: genome bits, index-raster bits, changed color indices, exact regeneration
shows: A compact procedural description plus a shared interpreter can generate and regenerate a larger indexed-color field within a restricted family.
does_not_show: General image compression or learned generation; the first implementation is procedural.

title: Pixel Organism
operation: decode phenotype / simulate lifetime / mutate / select
measure: genome distance, body distance, food, survival, energy, selected-world score, held-out mean
shows: One finite inherited description can deterministically generate both a visible pixel phenotype and a small recurrent controller whose mutations produce measurable behavioral changes.
does_not_show: Open-ended evolution, consciousness, ecological realism, gradient learning, or general intelligence; selection is a deterministic hill-climbing baseline.

title: Original Field Dynamics
shows: How local multidimensional field mechanics behave under direct interventions.
does_not_show: Learning, reasoning, or evidence for MPF performance.
